items.followUp: Describe how a web browser retrieves and displays a webpage.

rubric.why: Shows that the browser asks the web server for the requested webpage.
rubric.description: States that the browser sends a request to the web server.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying both the request and the web server.

rubric.why: Shows that the browser processes the received page and presents it to the user.
rubric.description: Explains that the browser interprets the received page and displays it.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning the received HTML or webpage and its display.

modelAnswer: The browser sends a request for a webpage to the web server, usually using its URL.
The server returns the webpage as an HTML document; the browser interprets the HTML and displays the webpage on the screen.

items.followUp: What does a hyperlink do when a user clicks it?

rubric.why: Identifies a hyperlink as an element on a webpage that can be clicked.
rubric.description: States that a hyperlink is clickable text or an image.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing a hyperlink as clickable text or an image.

rubric.why: Identifies that a hyperlink takes the user to a destination.
rubric.description: States that clicking a hyperlink leads to another webpage, document, or location.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming a valid destination.

modelAnswer: A hyperlink is clickable text or an image on a webpage.
When clicked, it takes the user to another webpage, document, or location.
